name: medallion-architecture-airflow
description: Medallion Architecture Demo with Airflow, dbt, and DuckDB

scripts.airflow:trigger: docker-compose exec airflow airflow dags trigger medallion_pipeline
scripts.airflow:list-dags: docker-compose exec airflow airflow dags list
scripts.airflow:ui: echo Opening Airflow UI at http://localhost:8080 && start http://localhost:8080
scripts.dev:start: npm run docker:start && npm run docker:logs
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run docker:clean && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:start
